name: racelab-monorepo
description: RaceLab — root runner so 'all green' is ONE reproducible command (P0-3). Each package keeps its own node_modules + test script; this just chains them in dependency order. CI (ci/racelab-ci.yml) and humans run the same thing.

scripts.test-all: npm --prefix packages/schema test && npm --prefix packages/engine test && npm --prefix packages/kb test && npm --prefix packages/storage test && npm --prefix packages/account test && npm --prefix packages/weather test && npm --prefix packages/speedhive test && npm --prefix packages/sessions test && npm --prefix packages/logbook test && npm --prefix packages/sheets test && npm --prefix packages/garage test && npm --prefix packages/tracks test && npm --prefix packages/strategy test && npm --prefix packages/social test && npm --prefix server test
scripts.typecheck-all: npm --prefix packages/schema run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/engine run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/mobile exec tsc -- --noEmit
